english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling reassured once a worry is gone.
Use this when comfortable means reassured or not worried, rather than for physical comfort.

examples.english: I’m really relieved now that the exam is finally over.
examples.traditional: 個考試終於考完，我真係放心喇。
examples.jyutping: go3 haau2 si3 zung1 jyu1 haau2 jyun4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 fong3 sam1 laa3

examples.english: You can feel comfortable knowing I’ll keep an eye on him.
examples.jyutping: nei5 fong3 sam1 ngo5 wui5 tai2 zyu6 keoi5
